title: Pablo Exclusive Bubblegum Nicotine  Pouches - 30mg / Pouch
description: Pablo Bubblegum Nicotine Pouches offer a punchy nicotine experience with a sweet and familiar bubblegum flavour. These pouches are crafted for discreet, smoke-free enjoyment, combining classic sweetness with a satisfying 30mg per pouch of nicotine. Each pouch fits neatly under the upper lip, where it gradually dissolves to release nicotine without smoke, vapour, or lingering odour. The result is a clean, convenient way to manage nicotine cravings anytime, anywhere. Pablo is known for its powerful blends and quirky flavour profiles, and Bubblegum stands out as a fun and flavourful option for experienced pouch users seeking something playful. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
